page.overview:
Who is Charlotte Kato?

Charlotte Kato is the 28th son and 49th child of the Charlotte Family and the middle triplet brother of Kanten and Montb. He also is an officer of the Big Mom Pirates and serves as Totto Land's , governing over Tanega Island.

Kato is a very tall and slim man. He wears a helmet that heavily resembles a pumpkin, being dark orange and covered in vertical creases, with dark green leaves and a stem on top. The eyes are slits and the mouth is extremely wide and thin, giving him the appearance of a jack-o-lantern. He wears a black shirt with target patterns on it, a thin purple cape, round gray pads on his shoulders, and gray armor plates on his forearms. He also wears a short kilt and leg armor that goes up to around where his kilt ends.

As a son of the Charlotte Family and member of Big Mom Pirates, Kato is very loyal to his family and crew, as he took part in a meeting to deal with their issues before the wedding and helped them go after the Straw Hat Pirates after they escaped from the wedding.

As the Minister of Seeds, Kato has authority over Tanega Island, and as an officer of the Big Mom Pirates, he has authority over lower-ranking members of his crew.
